{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Feathered Edge Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Feathered Edge Icon.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Feathered Edge Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Feathered Edge Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 15 |TotK= 6 }} |durability= 27 |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Feathered Edges''' are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Feathered Edge|Feathered Edges|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 15 |durability = 27 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Feathered Edge}} Feathered Edges are lightweight, double-edged swords forged by [[Rito]] craftsmen, designed so that Rito warriors can soar into battle unaffected by their weight. They belong to the [[Rito Gear]] equipment archetype, a grouping of [[Weapon]]s with Rito origins. Feathered Edges are primarily found on the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. A Feathered Edge can be found inside [[Treasure Chest]]s in [[Rota Ooh Shrine]] and at [[Dragon Bone Mire]]. In addition, two [[Blue Lizalfos]] on the Tabantha Frontier equip a Feathered Edge. One can be found just south of [[Kolami Bridge]] at a [[Monster Stronghold]], while the other is hiding in a path north of Kolami Bridge. The [[Lizalfos]] and the swords reappear every [[Blood Moon]]. In [[Master Mode]], another Treasure Chest can be found containing a Feathered Edge at the [[Waterfall]] in [[Hebra Plunge]]. Being made of metal, Feathered Edges will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they are capable of conducting [[Electricity]]. They will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], but they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They can be picked up and manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_031" |Life = 27 |Power = 15 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 14 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 3 |BuyingPrice = 12 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = One-Handed Weapon |strength = 6 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Feathered Edge}} {{Stub|TotK}} When swung, Feathered Edges create a gust of wind that launches Enemies back. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Name citation * Model and icon in the infobox * Where the Item is found * How much the Item costs, how much it can be sold for * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} An ancient version of the Feathered Edge appears as a [[One-Handed Weapon]].
